page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 vCPUs operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A defining characteristic of this server is its massive bundled local storage, consisting of 70866 GB of HDD capacity. This high-density local storage configuration is paired with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance type.

Given the substantial local HDD storage capacity and balanced compute-to-memory ratio, the ecs.d1.6xlarge is designed for storage-intensive workloads. It is highly suitable for big data processing, distributed file systems, data warehousing, and large-scale log analysis where massive sequential storage capacity is required at a cost-effective storage-per-resource ratio.
